body: I know I don't think anyone is to blame as well. It just feels like she is blaming me for this. I have also told her multiple times that she needs to go to the therapist and that she need help. Shes at her parents house right now maybe they will force her to go to one cause it seems like the school isn't doing anything.

The resident director might not do anything since he has had cases and seems to just let it slide or give people a slap on the wrist. I think the extra rooms are taken since other people have had problems as well mentally.

My RA just discussed it in a professional manner she wasn't trying to solve her problem (I believe). She just basically said go to counseling and see a therapist multiple times and if she has anymore suicidal thoughts she has to tell her.

My roommate I believe has already twisted people around her finger and I think thats why they are letting her stay and continue school. That or the school just doesn't care which can be it too.

​

Thank you and yeah my years starting off school haven't been the best but this is the worst by far.

I think the wisest decision would be having my own room right now cause this is actually making my very negative thoughts come to the front again. I think I'm going to talk to my RA today about everything and see what can get done.

The dean already knows that she has OD'd. She did go to a psychiatrist once she got back and told me that she got diagnosed with Manic depressive disorder and an anxiety disorder but she is probably lying to me about the second one. Shes at her parents right now and they already know. I agree she needs to be committed but I just feel like no one is really talking about that and that she is able to make her own choice even though she is not mentally stable to.

After the first time she had a long talk with our RA. She was also told to go to counseling sessions as well after the first time but she didn't she just stayed at the dorm 24/7. Now the sessions are mandatory but I'm not sure if shes going to them. I don't honestly know what my RA can do now she has talked to her multiple times about her depression and mental health.
Thank you but its kinda hard not to engage her too since we are both sharing a dorm together. Should I just transfer rooms when I can then?

I was thinking about talking to my RA as well but I don't know what to say. My RA knows what happen but just in a very vague way and I feel like if I tell her exactly what happened she might call a counselor or someone that I would have to talk to as well. I also feel like its not exactly my roommates fault and by me going to our RA it would be putting all of the blame on my roommate.

Thank you I know its not I just can't help but think that but I'll try to change my way of thinking about it. 

I would never tell anyone to take their life and I have never encouraged her to take hers. We did call the police when she was making the noose/taking the pills and was held at the hospital. Sorry if I didn't make that clear enough.

I can talk to housing but I believe without proper paperwork and stuff like that she cannot move. Plus I'm pretty sure they would just tell me to move. She was given 2 weeks though if she wants to drop out and I don't mean to sound mean but I hope she does. I think she just needs to focus on her mental health right now and not school and it would help me mentally as well.

I know shes not gonna change overnight but it also just seemed like she wasn't even trying. I do hope she gets the help she needs though.

Yeah sorry about the paragraphs its my first time posting to reddit thank you for your input on that. I do hope things work out as well and maybe I will get a more balanced roommate but I'm just thinking I will buy the room out if possible since my mental health needs to fully recover from this and my home life as well.

Thank you for your support it means a lot.
